items.summary: Anthropic: Hoovers up the world’s knowledge, destroys it so they’re the only ones who have it, sells everyone else access, and then decides what you can and can’t see from it… …and no one can use it to make new models that compete with them either. Does that sum it up? Hedgie (@HedgieMarkets) 🦔AI companies are bulk-buying rare books, scanning them through high-speed machines that cut the spines off, and shredding the originals. A service called ISBNdb facilitates orders of up to a million books and keeps buyers anonymous. Pre-2022 books are premium because they're free of AI-generated text. A federal judge ruled the practice is fair use because eliminating the original means only one copy exists at a time. Anthropic hired the former head of Google Books partnerships to obtain "all the books in the world." My Take This got to me.
